family.description: Cobalamin adenosyltransferase This family contains the gene products of PduO and EutT which are both cobalamin adenosyltransferases. PduO is a protein with ATP:cob(I)alamin adenosyltransferase activity. The main role of this protein is the conversion of inactive cobalamins to AdoCbl for 1,2-propanediol degradation [[cite:PUB00013593]].The EutT enzyme appears to be an adenosyl transferase, converting CNB12 to AdoB12 [[cite:PUB00009955]].
family.name: Cobalamin adenosyltransferase

record.description: Cobalamin adenosyltransferase This family contains the gene products of PduO and EutT which are both cobalamin adenosyltransferases. PduO is a protein with ATP:cob(I)alamin adenosyltransferase activity. The main role of this protein is the conversion of inactive cobalamins to AdoCbl for 1,2-propanediol degradation [[cite:PUB00013593]].The EutT enzyme appears to be an adenosyl transferase, converting CNB12 to AdoB12 [[cite:PUB00009955]].

evidence.explanation: SeEutT metal-motif residues lie outside PF01923; assembly changes and source inconsistencies remain.
LmEutT accepts cob(I)inamide but not cob(II)inamide in the tested biological reducing systems; transition-metal independence does not exclude MgATP.
ADP redox Methods conflict with the ATP figure caption; donor truncations and exact MMAB construct assignment matter.

discussions.notes: PF01923 is former DUF80, currently Cob_adeno_trans/IPR016030. Separate PduO, EutT and MMAB experimental systems must not be joined into one observed chain. The active SePduO1-185 construct includes flanking sequence; SeEutT H67/C79/C80/C83 and LrPduO F187/tail183-188 fall outside their PF01923 matches. Historical tags and clone endpoints remain qualified. No-added-metal SePduO retains activity; Zn-loaded SeEutT resists the oxidation that disables Fe-loaded protein; LmEutT has no demonstrated transition-metal requirement but still uses MgATP. LmEutT accepts cob(I)inamide but not cob(II)inamide with the tested biological reducing systems. Human MMAB ADP supports bound product in FigureS1 without sustained release; AMP spectra cannot distinguish absent binding from unchanged coordination. These negatives do not generalize across all members. Retain Johnson2001 dose-unit conflicts; Johnson2004 1-193/1-293 label and PPPi percentage discrepancy; Mera2009 reduction versus adenosylation-lag wording; Moore2014 C83A zinc, extinction units, reconstitution ratio and arabinose concentration conflicts; Costa2018 supplement numbering and catalytic-efficiency arithmetic; Gouda2023 ATP-caption versus ADP-methods discrepancy. No silent source corrections. Gouda2023 ADP single-turnover spectra are retained in the ledger; the specific panel's reductant details require further verification before a graph is added.
